description: Source file implementing the CertAndCTVerifier class, which manages certificate and CT verification processes, including verification flow control and callback handling.

classes.name: CertAndCTVerifier
classes.description: Class responsible for verifying certificates and Certificate Transparency (CT) data, coordinating between CertVerifier and CTVerifier.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification and, if successful, performs CT verification.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration for the underlying cert_verifier.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the cert_verifier.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the cert_verifier.

methods.name: OnCertVerifyComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of certificate verification, triggers CT verification if verification succeeded.
